kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نأتكل (form VIII)
# نَأْتَكِلُ (naʔtakilu) /naʔ.ta.ki.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
# نَأْتَكِلَ (naʔtakila) /naʔ.ta.ki.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
# نَأْتَكِلْ (naʔtakil) /naʔ.ta.kil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
